use core.files as files
use core.process as process
use core.encoding.json as json
use core.text as text

struct Report {
    count: Int
    name: String
    note: String
}

fn run() {
    path :: process.argv().get(1) ?? panic("missing path")
    input :: files.read(path) ?? panic("read failed")
    lines :: input.lines()
    count := 0
    name := ""
    note := ""
    loop line in lines {
        fields :: text.splitn(line, "\t", 2)
        key :: fields.get(0) ?? panic("bad key")
        value :: fields.get(1) ?? panic("bad value")
        if key == "count" -> count = value.to_int() ?? panic("bad count")
        if key == "name" -> name = ~value
        if key == "note" -> note = ~value
    }
    report :: Report{count: count, name: name, note: note}
    print(json.to_string(report))
}
